label: Cyberpunk RED — Social: Reputation, Roles & Humanity

steps.note: Reputation ranges 0–10. Higher rep unlocks social advantages: better prices, rumors, NPC reactions. Deeds are the public record of notable acts.

steps.label: view your reputation score, tier, and notable deeds

steps.cmd: +rep/deed Took down Militech's data vault single-handed
steps.label: record a notable deed to your rep sheet

steps.note: A Facedown is a social combat showdown. Both sides roll COOL + Reputation + 1d10. Tied totals re-roll once; a second tie is a stalemate. The loser is 'impressed' for the scene (~5 min) and takes -2 to any attack against the winner.

steps.label: contested facedown — winner imposes 'impressed' on the loser
clear an impressed condition on yourself

steps.note: Each role has a unique ability that scales with role rank (1–10, starting at rank 4).

steps.label: view your role, rank, and ability description

steps.note: Role-specific example: Rockerboy uses Charismatic Impact to sway crowds. Fixer uses Operator to source goods. Solo uses Combat Sense for initiative bonuses.
Each cyberware piece costs Humanity Loss (HL). EMP = empBase - floor(HL/10). At EMP 0 the character goes cyberpsycho.

steps.label: view current HL, EMP, and cyberpsychosis risk
gain humanity from a meaningful connection — 2d6 HL recovery (24h cooldown per type)

steps.note: Other gain types: achievement (1d6+2), kindness (1d6), memory (1d3). Each has a 24h cooldown.
Therapy sessions help characters recover HL over time. Crisis intervention handles emergency cyberpsychosis. Both require Medtech role or Admin.

steps.label: view HL, EMP, and therapy history

steps.note: +therapy/session <target> — Medtech conducts HL recovery session (EMP+psychiatry vs DV). +therapy/crisis <target> — emergency cyberpsychosis intervention. Both require Medtech role.
